nodes.label: traces subsystem (scripts/traces/ package, scripts/traces.py entry, skills/review-traces)
sources: one reader per trace source
attempt reader (*.attempt.json, *.running markers)
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/traces.py selftest -k attempts` exits 0: a fixture dir with completed, failed, interrupted and running records yields one attempt per record with status and exit code; a record with no runs.jsonl row still appears

nodes.label: run-row reader (runs.jsonl: cost, turns, duration, model, effort, strays)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k runs` exits 0: a legacy row without attempt_id or file, a row with both, and a malformed line are read as two rows and one skipped line

nodes.label: result reader (<role>-L*.md Status, Verdict, plan defect, Changes, Notes, header model)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k results` exits 0: builder done/blocked/inherited/statusless and verifier pass/fail/no-verdict fixtures classify as steps.py next does (shared functions, no re-implementation)

nodes.label: transcript reader (stream-json .log: tool_use names and inputs, tool_result is_error, hook denials, rate_limit_event, result totals)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k transcripts` exits 0: a fixture log with 5 Bash tool_use, one run_in_background denial (hook_response), one rate_limit_event and prose lines mixed in yields tool_calls=5, denials=1, rate_limits=1; a missing .log yields nulls, not an error

nodes.label: fanout reader (report.md rows and Run line, fanout.log, <lane>-<id>.log, gate-<lane>-<id>-<k>[-a<n>].log, run-id prefix or legacy)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k fanout` exits 0: a legacy lanes dir (no prefixes, gate-…-<k>.log) and a prefixed one (fanout.log, gate-…-<k>-a<n>.log) both yield lane outcomes, gate attempts with rc, and per-line run ids (null for legacy)

nodes.label: git reader (worktree list, refs, integration reflog resets, ls-files runtime files, merge/close/wip commits)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k git` exits 0: a throwaway repo with a nested .worktrees/x/.worktrees/tmp/builder-1 worktree, a tracked foo.log, a `reset: moving to` reflog entry and a `wip(T-0001): driver failed rc=3` commit yields each fact; nothing in the repo is written (git status and reflog count unchanged after the read)

nodes.label: ticket reader (tickets.load incl. closed dot folders, id problems, config external_branch, notes.md)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k tickets` exits 0: a root with 0001-a, .0002-b and a duplicate id yields slug->id and status for both folders and one duplicate-id problem, using tickets.load and tickets.problems

nodes.label: bench baseline reader (bench/results/*/: cost per verifier-passed step, hidden check)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k bench` exits 0: two fixture result dirs give the median cost per passed step; no results dir gives baseline=null and the cost detector reports 'no baseline' instead of a finding

nodes.label: event table: attempt-centric join with stable ids
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k join` exits 0: attempt.json joins its runs.jsonl row by attempt_id, a legacy row joins by result name in the same dir, an orphan row gets id legacy:<relpath>; every row has attempt_id, ticket, step, superseded, role, level, attempt_k, status, verdict, turns, cost_usd, secs, tool_calls, exit_code, sources[]

nodes.label: store and cursor: out dir in the reviewing project, incremental re-read by source path
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k store` exits 0: two ingests of an unchanged corpus produce byte-identical events.jsonl and the second reads no source file (read count from an injected counter is 0 for unchanged files); appending one attempt re-reads only that dir; `--out` outside the analyzed repo leaves `git status --porcelain` of the analyzed repo empty

nodes.label: detectors: deterministic, thresholds in one table

escalation detectors over results and Plan review (replan loops, recurring findings, unchanged-verdict bumps, plan-defect refusals by lint rule, wrong resume order, statusless and no-verdict runs, exit 3, attempts with no run row)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k escalation` exits 0: one positive fixture per detector fires exactly one finding with a path+line or attempt_id evidence entry and a cause_hint file; the paired negative control (same fixture minus the defect) fires none

nodes.label: plan-quality detectors (criteria never red via opt-in rerun at base-sha, contract dependents across steps, scope decision recorded as prose only)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k plan` exits 0: a criterion green at base-sha in a throwaway repo fires never-red only with --rerun-criteria and the worktree is removed afterwards; an earlier step's ## Changes path cited in a later fail note fires contract-dependents; two scope-blocked builders on one path with no `scope widened:` line fire scope-prose; each negative control fires none

nodes.label: hygiene detectors over git and fanout (stray or nested worktrees, tracked runtime files, integration resets with lost-edit signals, stale log lines and overwritten gate logs by run id, id collisions and unregistered branches)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k hygiene` exits 0: the src-git and src-fanout fixtures fire one finding per defect with the file path or worktree path as evidence; a clean repo and a prefixed lanes dir fire none

nodes.label: cost and transcript detectors (cost per verified step vs baseline, builder attempts per step, polling loops and timeouts, hook denials, rate limits; host load optional)
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k cost` exits 0: a task at 3x the fixture baseline fires cost-over-baseline with the ratio; a transcript with 6 identical `sleep`/`kill -0` Bash calls fires polling with the call count; a run with no load series carries load=unknown in its evidence; negative controls fire none

nodes.label: findings writer: findings.jsonl, clusters.json, stable ids, first/last seen, severity ranking, caps
nodes.accept: `traces.py selftest -k findings` exits 0: rerunning detect on the same table keeps every finding id and updates last_seen only; `clusters --max 2` returns the two highest-severity clusters grouped by cause_hint file

nodes.label: CLI: traces.py ingest <repo> [--lanes-dir …] [--out DIR] [--rerun-criteria]; detect; clusters --max N; selftest [-k NAME]
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/traces.py ingest . && python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/traces.py detect` exits 0 on this repo with zero model calls (no `claude` or `codex` process spawned: `SDLC_DRY_RUN`-free run under a PATH with a stub claude that exits 99 succeeds) and prints the events and findings paths

nodes.label: selftest suite: per-detector positive fixture plus negative control, corpus regression on this repo's night-2026-09-29 trail
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/traces.py selftest` exits 0 and prints one PASS line per detector and one per negative control; `grep -c 'traces.py' plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.sh` is 1

nodes.label: skills/review-traces/SKILL.md: stages 3 to 6 orchestration
diagnose stage: per cluster (capped) a question handoff citing only the evidence files, archaeologist L1 or scout L1, cause layer and plugin file in its result
nodes.accept: `grep -q 'archaeologist L1' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md && grep -q 'clusters --max' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md`; the cluster handoff template in the skill names the evidence paths and forbids reading outside them; `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.py plugins/sdlc-lite` exits 0

nodes.label: verify stage: one step handoff per finding whose acceptance criteria are the finding's evidence commands, verifier L1, unreproduced findings dropped
nodes.accept: `grep -q 'verifier L1' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md`; the skill's finding-step template passes `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py lint` on a rendered fixture; a Verdict fail drops the finding from the propose list

nodes.label: propose stage: planner L2 drafts one ticket per confirmed sdlc-lite finding with a failing fixture or selftest check as its criterion
nodes.accept: `grep -q 'planner L2' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md`; the propose handoff template requires per ticket: Repro from evidence, Expected, Actual quoted from the finding, and one red check command

nodes.label: file stage: one AskUserQuestion round, `tickets.py new bug` for approved drafts, non-sdlc findings to <review task>/report.md, model-call cap stated as clusters + findings + 1
nodes.accept: `grep -q 'AskUserQuestion' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md && grep -q 'tickets.py' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md && grep -q 'report.md' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/review-traces/SKILL.md`; the skill states that unattended runs file nothing

nodes.label: integration slice (serial): check.sh wiring, conductor route, handoff-format ignore guidance for .sdlc/runtime/, Codex adapter skill list, docs index
nodes.accept: `bash plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.sh` exits 0 with the traces selftest in its output; `grep -q 'review-traces' plugins/sdlc-lite/agents/conductor.md`; `grep -q 'sdlc/runtime' plugins/sdlc-lite/skills/handoff-format/SKILL.md`; `python3 scripts/check-packaging.py` exits 0

actions.label: enumerate every attempt, including interrupted and failed ones that never reached runs.jsonl
read cost, turns, duration, model, effort, stray lists per run
read builder status, verifier verdict, plan-defect tag, changed paths from result files, newest by record order
read tool calls, denials, rate limits from a transcript when it exists; tolerate its absence (logs are gitignored)
attribute each attempt to ticket id, task dir, step n, superseded flag, attempt ordinal
read lane outcomes, run ids, gate attempts, driver logs in both the legacy and the run-id-prefixed layouts
read git facts: worktrees, branches, reflog resets, tracked runtime files, merge/close/wip commits, without writing
read ticket state, id problems, config lines, notes
read the bench baseline cost per verified step
join everything into one row per attempt with a stable id, synthesizing ids for legacy rows
persist the table and re-read only changed sources on the next ingest
never write into the analyzed repo; keep outputs and cursor in the reviewing project
detect replan loops and recurring findings
detect a level bump whose next verdict repeats the previous fail
detect plan-defect refusals and group them by lint rule
detect criteria that never went red (opt-in rerun at base-sha)
detect polling loops, timeouts and background denials, with host load when a series exists
detect cost per verified step above baseline and steps with many builder attempts
detect stray or nested worktrees and tracked runtime files
detect integration-tree resets and lost-edit signals
detect stale log lines by run id and overwritten gate logs
detect a resume that built a later step before the blocked one
detect a later step failing on a dependent of an earlier step's changed contract
detect a scope decision recorded as prose while the criterion stayed unchanged
detect ticket id collisions and unregistered external branches
detect attempts with no run row, exit 3 results, statusless or no-verdict results, stale running markers
give every finding evidence pointers (path and line, or attempt id) and a cause hint (layer, plugin file)
cluster findings by cause hint, rank by severity, cap the list handed to model stages
keep finding ids stable across runs so reruns diff instead of duplicating
prove each detector bites with a positive fixture and stays quiet on a negative control, inside check.sh
run stages 1 and 2 end to end with zero model calls
diagnose each cluster with one read-only role that reads only the cited evidence and names the cause layer and plugin file
verify each finding independently and drop the unreproduced
draft one ticket per confirmed sdlc-lite finding with a failing check
file only after user approval; route non-sdlc findings to a report; unattended files nothing
bound model calls per run by the cluster and finding caps
route a 'review the traces' ask from the conductor to the skill
keep the runtime dir out of commits in the ignore guidance
regress against a real local corpus (this repo's night-2026-09-29 trail and lane logs)
